info.title: Packd REST API
info.description: Database-session authentication via Auth.js Google OAuth. Private responses are no-store. All nested resource IDs are scoped to active trip membership. Mutations require same-origin JSON, at most 16 KiB, and allow 120/user/minute (invitations: 20/user/minute). Auth library routes and health checks are separately documented in README.

post.summary: Generate sourced activity suggestions without creating proposals

429.description: Mutation, user AI, or global daily quota exceeded; failed generations consume quota

502.description: Search/model failure or invalid generated output

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Must equal the public application origin. Browser sets this automatically.

post.description: LangChain + Claude with Tavily search. Five requests/user/minute and a global rolling daily limit (default 100). At most five draft suggestions. Explicit maxCostMinor excludes unknown/over-cap estimates. Selected suggestions are saved separately through POST activities. No votes or itinerary entries are generated.

session.name: authjs.session-token
session.description: Auth.js uses __Secure-authjs.session-token over HTTPS. Obtain via Google OAuth; never distribute test sessions.

timezone.description: Valid IANA timezone. End date must not precede start date.

token.description: Returned once; only a hash is stored.

maxCostMinor.description: Estimated USD cents per person per activity, not the whole trip budget
